title: Keep fraction scroll pacing consistent in notebook and phone layouts
summary: Shared document reader preserves scroll distance across viewport sizes; focused checks pass. Exact pacing remains available for subjective refinement, and first-entry compositor preparation is a separate issue.

verificationRecords.notes: All three hosts preserve operation distance and semantic position across height changes; phone viewport evidence, not physical touch testing.
Nine checks cover viewport-independent cadence, embedded pre-hydration behavior, endpoints, reverse and invalid geometry.
Three moving portions preserve one-pixel changes and exact reversal.
